## Findings

### Anti-patterns

- "apps/discography/scripts/musicbrainz/build.py" exports 4 declaration(s) (fold, split_credit, artist, uniq) that no file in the project imports [warning] (apps)
- "apps/discography/src/ui/pages.tsx" exports 1 declaration(s) (pages) that no file in the project imports [warning] (apps)
- "apps/rota/src/main.tsx" exports 1 declaration(s) (applyScheme) that no file in the project imports [warning] (apps)
- "apps/seedbed/src/site-embed.ts" exports 10 declaration(s) (handles, mountChapter, dress, kitFindings, mountRota, …) that no file in the project imports [warning] (apps)
- "Core" imports "Core Cli" on 6 edge(s) while the 43 edge(s) between them run the other way — the minority direction looks like a layering violation [warning] (core)
- "packages/core/src/blocks.ts" is production code imported only by tests (25 importer(s), all test files) — either it is dead or its real caller is missing [warning] (core)
- "packages/core/src/index.ts" is imported from 6 zones (core-document, tests-core-document, tests-core-integration, tests-core-support, tests-core-unit, tests-packages) — a cross-cutting dependency every one of them is coupled to [warning] (core)
- "Core Document" imports "Core Cli" on 1 edge(s) while the 32 edge(s) between them run the other way — the minority direction looks like a layering violation [warning] (core-document)
- "packages/core/src/document/index.ts" is production code imported only by tests (120 importer(s), all test files) — either it is dead or its real caller is missing [warning] (core-document)
- "packages/core/src/graph/types.ts" is imported from 6 zones (core, core-document, core-invariants, core-mutations, core-ops, core-sync) — a cross-cutting dependency every one of them is coupled to [warning] (core-graph)
- ... and 20 more

### Patterns

- The core package has a many-to-one dependency on core-schema (118 imports) and acts as the hub that every sub-folder imports back into (schema, ops, mutations, invariants, sync). Those back-imports to the top-level barrel are the real layering leak: sub-folders should import sibling modules directly, leaving top-level files as the only consumers of the barrel. [warning] (core)
- The inbound edges from core-cli and core-sync (minority direction) suggest document code reaching for CLI/sync types; these should be moved to a neutral types module so the compiler stays free of CLI and sync concerns. [warning] (core-document)
- Clean, high-cohesion foundation module with a small, stable API; the schema and graph mutual edges (3 and 2) are the only coupling to watch, and they form a small cycle at the zone level that should be broken by moving the shared types to one side. [warning] (core-graph)
- core-invariants and core-document import each other (3 edges each way), a zone-level cycle; extract the shared rule shape types into invariants/types.ts (which document would import) so that invariants stays below document. [warning] (core-invariants)
- mutations and schema depend on each other (36 one way, 2 back), and mutations imports from the core barrel; this is a layered-cycle risk. Keep node-ref and types in a leaf module and have schema import only from it. [warning] (core-mutations)
- Well-layered mid-tier (graph below, core above) with high internal cohesion in the call graph (0.9); the only leak is the 6 back-imports to core, which should point at specific modules. [warning] (core-ops)
- A model leaf zone: fully self-contained with a small, clear consumer set (core, document, cli). Contract-in-core, palettes-in-primitives is a clean, intentional interface. [info] (core-theme)

### Relationships
